verdict.rationale: Bugbot is a managed PR-review agent that runs automatically on every PR update. It flags bugs, security issues and code-quality problems, reads existing top-level and inline PR comments to avoid duplicate suggestions, and posts 'Fix in Cursor/Web' links. It works across GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps, and Automations add Security Agents that also review PRs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of review quality, and detailed documentation of how feedback is contextualized (e.g. codebase-aware inline comments or rule-driven customization)
